agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has two massive bodies (3: 15.68, 4: 10.53) on colliding trajectories with large G~4.12 and near-max dt~0.0302. They converge from ~1.22 separation at step 7 to 0.87 at step 8 to 0.406 at step 9, causing acceleration and velocity to spike (speed ~9.6-9.9, kinetic 1247, potential -1412). Fixed dt with only 6 substeps per outer step is insufficient to resolve the softened (eps 0.3) close encounter, causing leapfrog integration error and large energy drift (~58.2 > allowed 53.25). Reducing dt to 0.01 with same steps eliminates the violation, confirming timestep resolution as cause.
